description: Runs one read-only SQL query over the tables of a report's datasheets, to check a figure before it goes on a slide or to explore data before shaping it. It reads the copies stored at the sources' last reads, never a source, and saves nothing: a datasheet's table is the one getReportDatasheetData answers. Only the report's editors may. At most 200 rows and 30 seconds a query. Your queries run one at a time, together with your previewReportDatasheetChanges and saveReportDatasheetChanges calls and the renderReportSlides calls that carry datasheetChanges: send the next only once this one answers, never several at once, and check several figures in one query, as columns of one row or rows of a UNION ALL. At most 30 queries and previewReportDatasheetChanges calls a minute per user, counted together.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

sql.description: One read-only DuckDB query (`SELECT` or `WITH`). Its tables are the report's datasheets, named by their `id` from `listReportDatasheets` in double quotes, as in `SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM "<id>" GROUP BY region`. A column is a number when every value is one, else text, dates included: `CAST` an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) to `DATE` before `year()`, `date_trunc()` or date arithmetic. Give every computed column a name with `AS`.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: queryReportData
title: Query report data
